Name: Largemouth Bass Sprite Missing Pixel Fix
Author: helenaneedshugs
Description:
Due to [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/StardewValley/comments/cwz9mg/there_is_nearly_nothing_in_this_world_that_bugs/]screwyoucolin's cannot unsee thread[/url], I had to make this.
Replaces "springobjects.xmb" to correct the missing pixel in the Largemouth Bass sprite (and the grey controller in another sprite). 


[b]How to install:[/b]

[b]1. Navigate to "[/b]C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Maps"

[b]2. Create backup of the original[/b] [b]"[/b]springobjects.xnb"

[b]3. Unzip [/b][b]file "[/b]springobjects.zip"

[b]4. Replace file "[/b]springobjects.xnb"
